issues.explanation: The editor note attributes «سطح رواداری مخاطره» to both INSO 23728 clauses 7.3.2 and 8.1, but the printed evidence text supplied for 7.3.2 contains no such phrase — it is about privacy engineering objectives and is truncated at «پش» without ever reaching the phrase. The phrase is only attested in the 8.1 evidence.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the reference to clause 7.3.2 from the editor note regarding «سطح رواداری مخاطره»; retain only the 8.1 citation.

issues.explanation: The alternatives «رواداری مخاطره» and «رواداری ریسک» are not printed forms. The only attested INSO text is «سطح رواداری مخاطره سازمان» (INSO 23728 clause 8.1). Stripping «سطح» yields an unattested editorial construction, and «رواداری ریسک» has no printed source at all.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «رواداری مخاطره» in alternatives_fa with the exact printed phrase «سطح رواداری مخاطره»; remove «رواداری ریسک» from alternatives_fa or mark it explicitly as an editorial gloss with no INSO attestation.

issues.explanation: printed_evidence is empty and definition_fa is empty. All other NIST-context-only entries in this batch (risk, risk tolerance) carry an explicit «تعریف در بافت NIST» section labelled as such. Without any evidence or definition, there is no verifiable basis for «سنجش» as the rendering of NIST AI RMF MEASURE, and the entry is indistinguishable from an undocumented editorial choice.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a «تعریف در بافت NIST» entry to definition_fa (even if brief, e.g. the description of the MEASURE function from the NIST AI RMF source translated in the book), and/or add a citation of the translated NIST text as a printed_evidence item, so the choice of «سنجش» is traceable.

issues.explanation: Rule 1 requires preferred_fa to equal the term the cited standard prints. The only printed form in INSO 23733 clause 6.5.2 is plural «مخاطره‌های باقی‌مانده». The proposed preferred_fa «مخاطرهٔ باقی‌مانده» is an editorial singular construction with no independent INSO attestation. The editor note itself acknowledges this departure.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «مخاطره‌های باقی‌مانده» (the printed form) and list «مخاطرهٔ باقی‌مانده» as an alternative with a note that it is the editorial headword singular, not independently attested in the standard.

issues.explanation: definition_fa is empty despite INSO 42001 clause 3.20 printing a clear definition: «تعیین وضعیت یک نظام، فرایند (۳-۸) یا فعالیت.» Rule 2 requires source-specific definitions to be included and attributed.
issues.suggested_fix: Set definition_fa to: «تعریف در استاندارد ملی (INSO 42001، بند ۳.۲۰): تعیین وضعیت یک نظام، فرایند (۳-۸) یا فعالیت.»

issues.explanation: «PII» appears in both alternatives_fa and the acronym field. The project normalisation policy states that a Latin acronym belongs only in the acronym field, not in alternatives_fa.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «PII» from alternatives_fa; it is already correctly placed in the acronym field.
